out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 2% milk=45F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Milk was discarded during the inspection. (CORRECTED).

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: unlabeled squeeze bottles containing sauces were noted in the food prep area,
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CORRECTED.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Unmarked spary bottles of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.
